notes.title: Many Bug Fixes!
notes.content: Fixed all reported bugs, most notably ones that blocked the player such as the one in the Machine Factory optional dungeon.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a couple reported bugs.

 - Andromeda optional boss crashing in its opening attack sequence.
 - Could enter the Revolution Ruins too early in the story.
 - Database entry was not updated to match some skills.
